# The actions this repo may run, a copy of Settings → Actions → General → "Allow
# ChefControl, and select non-ChefControl, actions and reusable workflows". Keep the two in
# step: check-actions.sh tests every action the workflows use, and every action those
# actions use in turn, against this list, so one that's missing fails CI rather than a
# deploy. GitHub's own actions (actions/*, github/*) are always allowed, and every
# reference has to be a full commit SHA.
